KR.candidates: the candidatePool largest commons by Naver market value at the capture, after the name filters
KR.capture: every ranking input (Naver pages, candidates' price series) is retrieved after T's close (timing.marketClose), else the market is an error; a price series must also be retrieved after T's closes settle (prices.SETTLE_HOUR local time), else the market is an error (close_unsettled, never no_close_on_as_of or not_listed_on_as_of); no Naver marketStatus requirement
KR.dartStatuses: company.json status 000 is used; 010, 011, 012, 020, 021, 800 and 901 (key, IP, quota, maintenance) make the market an error; any other status is the member's universe_fetch_error; only 000, 013 and 100 are stored
KR.listedShares: marketValueRaw (KRW) / closePriceRaw of the same Naver row
KR.naverPages: every page up to totalCount, none empty, totalCount unchanged and rows == totalCount; otherwise the market is an error
KR.preferred: same first five code characters, last character not 0, name starting with the common name
KR.ranking: market cap at T's close = sum over the candidate's listed classes of listedShares x that class's close on T (prices.series with its window through T, requested through the build's Asia/Seoul date: request_through, not T+2; close_on_or_before); a preferred class without its own close on T (no session on T, every host HTTP 404, or a rejected original) uses the common close (rankingProxy, issue class_price_proxy), but one whose close is unsettled, traded on T without a published close (D17: close_unpublished, prices.unpublishedSessions) or whose download failed transiently (prices.transient_failure) makes the market an error (rebuild); members are the top candidates by that cap, ties by code; fewer than top ranked candidates is a market error
KR.smoke: a limited build takes the limit largest commons by Naver market value (rankingBasis naver_value) without prices and is never registered
KR.source: Naver KOSPI market-value ranking (candidates, listed shares); Yahoo daily closes via ratings.prices (market cap at T's close)
KR.unranked: only unrankedReasons leave a candidate unranked (unranked, issue candidate_unranked; never a stale close): no_close_on_as_of (its common's series, retrieved after T's closes settled, has no session on T: a halt; a session traded on T without a published close is not one, D17), symbol_not_found (every Yahoo host answers HTTP 404 for its common) and not_listed_on_as_of (every Yahoo host answers the request for its common's symbol, retrieved after T's closes settled, with a chart in KRW without a settled session from 400 days before T through T: sessions after T only (listed after T) or none (halted throughout); with HTTP 400 whose chart error description starts with "Data doesn't exist" (no session in the request: kept as the original, prices.NO_DATA); or with HTTP 404, provided at least one host answers without sessions as above); any other failure to price the common (a transient download failure, a rejected original: a symbol or currency mismatch, an undecodable response, any other HTTP 400, a close on T not published yet (D17: close_unpublished, or prices.UnpublishedClose when nothing in the window is published)), a class without listed shares or a class priced from a series retrieved before T's closes settled makes the market an error (rebuild): a failed download never removes a candidate

US.ff12Changed: when the downloaded Siccodes12 does not parse to the pinned definition (Ken French published a changed one) or does not parse at all, the stored original with the pinned definition is used: issue ff12_definition_changed_pinned_used, ff12Changed records the download; only without such an original does a changed definition stand (issue ff12_definition_changed, ff12Hash off the pin, refused by the registry) and an unparsable download make the US market an error
US.ff12Outage: when Siccodes12 cannot be fetched (offline: when the latest stored original cannot be read), a stored original whose parsed definition hashes to the pin is used (issue ff12_stored_original; ff12Fallback records the error); without one the US market is an error
US.ff12Pinned: the stored original with the pinned definition is the one kept under its own pointer (ken-french-siccodes12-pinned), else the latest stored, else any stored ken-french-siccodes12-*.zip whose content matches its name and whose parsed definition hashes to the pin
US.holdings: holdingsAsOf (the file's 'As of' date) must equal T_US; SSGA posts the holdings of T on the next US business day
US.issuer: SEC CIK via company_tickers.json (BRK.B -> BRK-B); one member per CIK, priced by the class with the largest SPY weight
US.sectors: Fama-French 12 from Siccodes12; SIC outside every range = Other

files.gate: the computability-check universe: parts in <T>-gate/, merged into <asOf>-gate.json; never the month's universe, and neither ever merges, replaces or removes the other's files
files.merged: data/ratings/universe/<asOf>.json = registry.merge_universe of the month's parts (asOf = the later T; a market without a part at that date uses its only part of the month, except in a merge of exactly the named markets: universe-merge --only), rewritten only when a part changes; an earlier merge of the month is removed only when every market it holds has the same T in the new merge
files.part: data/ratings/universe/<T>/<market>.json, one per market and T, never silently replaced
files.saveFailure: parts written but the month not merged: reported as part saved, month not merged (MonthNotMerged), never as not saved
files.smoke: parts in <T>-limit<N>/, merged into <asOf>-limit<N>.json; never the month's universe

members.excludedBy: financial rules only (US financialSic; KR financialKsic and 64992 with financialHoldingName)
members.fetchError: universe_fetch_error: a member whose CIK, SEC submissions, OpenDART corp_code/company.json or SIC/KSIC is unavailable, mismatched or unmapped stays eligible (fetchError names the step) and is scored insufficient
members.fetchErrorRule: market error when members with the issue / non-financial (eligible) members > fetchErrorLimit

timing.KR: rankingBasis; capturedAt = rankingCapturedAt = {first, last} retrieval of the ranking inputs (rankingRetrievedAt: Naver pages; closesRetrievedAt: the candidates' price series); marketStatus and pricedAt are informational
timing.US: holdingsAsOf = SPY 'As of' date; capturedAt = {first, last} = holdingsRetrievedAt
timing.build: each market records builtAt (UTC start of its build), completedAt, online and rulesHash; the registry checks each market's timing from them and refuses, for a registration or a coverage gate, a market whose part was not built online (online true; universe --offline replays stored originals)
timing.issues: holdings_date (US) against T; ranking_captured_before_close (KR smoke build; a full KR build fails instead); ff12_stored_original (US, R12); ff12_definition_changed_pinned_used (US)
